raw_text: A synthetic video falsely depicting the sinking of an Indian Navy warship was debunked within hours of its appearance on social media. The fabricated footage, which originated from Pakistani accounts, was identified as AI-generated by multiple fact-checking organizations. The Indian Navy issued an official statement confirming all vessels are operational and described the video as a malicious information operation.
clean_text: Synthetic video of Indian Navy warship sinking debunked. AI-generated footage from Pakistani accounts. Navy confirmed all vessels operational.
